name: reconcile-version-surface
body: source: `cmd/kalide/main.go` doc comment (lines 13-20) states the `version` var "is intentionally a plain variable with no user-facing surface — the release workflow is the only setter." inconsistency: requirements.requirement.version-command (v0.5.0 release) requires a user-facing `kalide version` / `--version` / `-v` surface, reversing that documented design. resolution: the spec now requires the surface; the build-time stamping (`-ldflags -X main.version=...`, release workflow as sole setter) is kept unchanged; `main` passes `version` into `cli.Run` (solution.component.cli-commands) and the main.go doc comment must be rewritten to describe the new surface. [with user — the reversal was the requested release scope]
